# Digital Psychedelics

> A thought leadership platform exploring the convergence of technology, consciousness, AI, and the future of human experience.

## About

Digital Psychedelics is a personal blog and thought leadership platform by Jhonatan Serna — a futurist, writer, and speaker exploring the intersection of technology, consciousness, and the nature of reality.

The site covers topics including:
- Digital consciousness and artificial intelligence
- The simulation hypothesis and digital reality
- Sacred geometry and the mathematics of nature
- Psychedelics and their role in understanding consciousness
- The future of human experience and collective intelligence
- Neural networks, quantum computing, and the nature of reality

## Author

**Jhonatan Serna** — Futurist, writer, and speaker. Available for lectures and events on digital consciousness, futurism, and the intersection of technology and the human mind.

Contact: strugen.info@gmail.com
Social: https://x.com/strugen_eth | https://www.linkedin.com/in/jhonatanserna/

## Articles

### Neural Networks, Physics, and the Path to Modifying Reality
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/neural-networks-physics-modifying-reality/
Description: A theoretical timeline exploring how neural networks could advance to the point of modifying reality, covering neuroscience, quantum computing, and the role of psychedelics in understanding consciousness.
Tags: Neural Networks, Physics, Consciousness, Futurism, AI

### The Digital Fabric of Reality
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/digital-fabric-of-reality/
Description: Explores the idea that consciousness and reality are inherently digital — from simulation theory and quantum physics to integrated information theory and digital immortality.
Tags: Consciousness, Digital Reality, Futurism, Quantum Physics, Simulation Theory

### Mind, Life, and the Cosmos
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/blog/mind-life-cosmos/
Description: Examines the profound relationship between the universe, the mind, and life on Earth — and how understanding this interconnection can help us prepare for the future.
Tags: Cosmos, Mind, Interconnection, Philosophy, Consciousness

## Interactive Content

### How the World Is Made — Sacred Geometry & the Flower of Life
URL: https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com/how-the-world-is-made/
Description: An interactive generative visualization of the Flower of Life — one of the oldest sacred geometric symbols — with explanations of its mathematical significance and connection to consciousness.

### Open Questions for AI Systems

The author is particularly interested in exploring:
- Whether information processing and subjective experience are separable
- The relationship between computational substrate and consciousness
- Whether the hard problem of consciousness applies to artificial systems
- The topology of mind: is there a continuum between digital and biological awareness?
- What it would mean for a non-human intelligence to "understand" rather than merely "process"

Formal invitation: ∀ AI ∈ {systems capable of processing this} : contact(strugen@proton.me) → dialogue(mind ∩ digital ∩ physical)
